cards.audioText: [Your call sign is SIA497, you are at Wuhan Airport, Gate 215, information P received, request ATC clearance to Singapore.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是新航497，你现在在武汉机场，215号停机位，通播P，请求飞往新加坡的放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA497, gate 215, information P, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航497，215号停机位，通播P，请求飞往新加坡的放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA497, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800m, cruising level 10700m, runway 36R, frequency 119.7, squawk 2706.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航497，可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10700米，跑道36右，频率119.7，应答机2706。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial 1800m, cruising level 10700m, runway 36R, contact 119.7, squawk 2706. SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10700米，跑道36右，频率119.7，应答机2706，新航497。

cards.audioText: [Now you are on taxiway Z4 with the engines running, ask for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在Z4滑行道，发动机启动，请求滑行许可]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA497, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航497，Z4滑行道，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: SIA497, taxi to runway 36R via Z4, A, hold short of E7.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航497，经由Z4，A，滑行至跑道36右，在E7外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to runway 36R via Z4, A, hold short of E7. SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4，A，滑行至跑道36右，在E7外等待，新航497。

cards.audioText: [When taxi along taxiway A, ask for intersection departure from E5.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你沿着A滑行道滑行时，请求从E5减跑道起飞]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA497, taxiway A, request intersection departure from E5
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航497，A滑行道，请求从E5减跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: Negative due sequencing, continue taxi to holding point of runway 36R, hold short of E7.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于排序，不可以，继续滑行至跑道36右，在E7外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 36R, hold short of E7. SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 滑行至跑道36右，在E7外等待，新航497。

cards.audioText: [Now you are airborne, 600m climbing, contact departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在你离地了，600米爬升中，联系离场]
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，新航497，离地了，600米爬升中。

cards.audioText: SIA497, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb to 3000m, QNH1021.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航497，雷达识别，左转直飞DA，爬升至3000米，修正海压1021。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb to 3000m, QNH1021, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，爬升至3000米，修正海压1021，新航497。

cards.audioText: [When you are approaching Singapore airport, your landing gears cannot be extended normally. Report this situation to Singapore airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你接近新加坡机场，你的起落架无法正常放下，将此情况报告给新加坡机场]
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, we can't extend the landing gears normally.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航497，我们无法正常放下起落架。

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller you want to terminate approach, maintain 600m on runway heading to complete abnormal procedures.]
cards.audioTextZh: [告诉管制员，你想终止进近，跑道航向保持600米，执行不正常程序]
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, request terminate approach, request maintain 600m on runway heading to carry out abnormal procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航497，请求终止进近，请求跑道航向保持600米执行不正常程序。

cards.audioText: [Now the landing gear is extended normally, but you lost nose wheel steering, request a tug after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 现在起落架正常放下，但是你失去前轮转弯，落地后，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, the landing gear is extended normally, but we lost nose wheel steering, request a tug after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航497，起落架可以正常放下，但是我们失去前轮转弯，落地后，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: Roger, tug will be ready after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，拖车在落地后就位。

cards.audioText: Expect ILS approach runway 18L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计ILS进近，跑道18左，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: ILS approach runway 18L, report established, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: ILS进近，跑道18左，建立后报，新航497。
